metricDefinitions.nativeSubmitMs: Historical field name: measures the whole Backend.Submit call, including managed preparation, queue gate, native Wait/ExecuteCommandLists/Signal, and submission bookkeeping. Not an isolated native driver duration or an unavoidable lower bound.

environment.build: Release .NET 10; external timing instrumentation; validation disabled for timings

limits: CPU wall timings include waiting and native submission; nested counters must not be added
RenderDoc event duration sums are not overlapping GPU frame wall time
Historical displacement uses an older material shader and is not a matched full-frame workload
Default output is not pixel-identical to historical capture; historical comparison is not an isolated single-change benchmark
No cross-vendor, Vulkan, 4K, or uncaptured GPU queue timeline measurement

crud.method: Release existing product assemblies; independent write/read branches; CPU BeginEdit+mutation+Commit only; no frame/GPU execution; 12 warmup + 36 samples; three alternating size orders. sameLabel repeats the identical value; emptyCommit has no setter.

memory.historicalScope: transient heaps only; three in-flight instances
memory.currentScope: TransientHeapBytes: one in-flight instance; GraphHeapBytes: all graph heaps including persistent resources

testLimit: The default full solution run has 3 failures outside the changed rendering code. Serialization and lifecycle reruns pass. ECS zero-allocation passes in isolation but still fails in the suite, including with tiering disabled. Do not claim an all-green solution.
